items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a data breach affecting customer information, caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system — a reminder that your personal data can be exposed even when you haven't dealt directly with the company at fault. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that attackers are actively exploiting a vulnerability in N-able N-central software used by IT teams across Australia. Organisations using this tool should ensure patches are applied immediately.

If you've stayed at Quest Hotels, monitor your email and bank accounts for unusual activity, and consider updating your password if you have an account with them.

featured.title: Quest Apartment Hotels confirms customer data breach linked to third-party vulnerability
